Method of Attack: Downloader running in memory after creating a suspended thread to inject itself into, connects to Trello for C2 communication
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with HTML smuggling delivering IMG or ISO files containing malicious LNK files
Compromised legitimate email accounts of diplomats
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing emails originating from compromised diplomat email addresses
Use of Atlassian Trello API for C2 communication
Use of ISO archives containing malicious LNK files
